mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, space, parent_id, name, depth, owner_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_file_folder d WHERE d.space = #{space} AND d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND d.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND (d.parent_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_file_folder p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY d.deleted_at DESC
SELECT FROM sys_file_folder WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file_folder SET parent_id = NULL, depth = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_file_folder p WHERE p.id = sys_file_folder.parent_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_file_folder WHERE id IN #{i}
